description:
[RSSAmp] The full text of one post, extracted from the publisher's own page and returned as prose. Takes the feed slug and post guid that search, get_feed and topic_posts return. The first reader pays for the fetch and everyone after them reads it out of the database, so the publisher is asked once rather than once per view. A post behind a paywall, on a site that is down, or by a publisher who asked not to be redistributed (reason publisher-opt-out) comes back with the feed's summary and a reason instead — never an error.

Served by RSSAmp (https://rssamp.com/mcp).

guid.description: The post's guid, as returned by the other tools.

name: rssamplifier_read_post
title: RSSAmp: Read a post
